input.query: SELECT app_version, count(*) AS attempts, sum(CASE WHEN reject_reason='doc_unreadable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreadable_rejections, avg(CASE WHEN is_kyc_approved THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS approval_rate FROM fct_kyc_attempts WHERE platform='android' AND doc_type='national_id' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY app_version ORDER BY app_version
